label: original-phase new token (m/o/k/h/i/2...) in a sequence that began with y or q
explanation: Almost entirely original-phase (99.9% of mass), mostly t=3..6 (never t<2, essentially never during delimiter/copy). Fires when the sequence started with y or q (first_tok y/q lift ~6x, prev2_tok y 5.5x; e, g, 3 weaker) and the current input is a first occurrence of a token from a preferred set (m strongest, then o, k, 2, h, i, r, n, w, j, u). The strongest activations are in sequences whose first 2-3 tokens are several y/q (e.g. y y y q o n, q y a h m). It does not fire on repeated tokens, on y/q inputs themselves, or in sequences with no early y/q/e. Response looks graded and distributed (input-token weight times an early-y/q hidden-state component), so a boolean predicate reaches only F1 ~0.44 on dev; looser seen(y,q) & in_first covers ~80% of mass at ~11% precision.
